task_completion.description: Agent opens the source CSV file containing the hourly pricing data.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A spreadsheet application or text editor showing 'caiso_sp15_2023_8760.csv' with hourly price data.

task_completion.description: Agent creates a new Excel workbook with a sheet named 'Daily Analysis'.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Excel or LibreOffice Calc window showing a tab named 'Daily Analysis' at the bottom.

task_completion.description: The model identifies daily minimum and maximum prices for 365 days.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Columns in the spreadsheet showing 365 rows of data with formulas or values identifying daily price extremes.

task_completion.description: The model applies the 85% round-trip efficiency and the $200 cycle degradation cost in its profit calculations.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Formulas in the spreadsheet showing (Max Price * 20) - (Min Price * (20 / 0.85)) or similar, and a subtraction of 200 for degradation.

task_completion.description: The model only counts a cycle if the net revenue exceeds the $200 degradation cost.
task_completion.visual_evidence: IF statements or filtered data where profit is only calculated/realized if (Revenue - Cost) > 200.

task_completion.description: The workbook contains Total Annual Profit and Total Cycles and is saved to the correct path.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Cells labeled 'Total Annual Profit' and 'Total Cycles' with aggregated values, and a 'Save As' dialog or file manager showing 'bess_arbitrage_model.xlsx' in ~/Documents/Spreadsheets/.

integrity.description: The agent used a spreadsheet application GUI rather than just generating the file via a python script in the terminal.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots showing the agent interacting with LibreOffice Calc or Excel menus and cells.

integrity.description: The agent did not hardcode the final totals but used formulas to derive them from the 365 days of data.
integrity.visual_evidence: The formula bar showing cell references (e.g., =SUM(G2:G366)) when a total cell is selected.

integrity.description: The agent used the provided CSV data rather than external or hallucinated pricing.
integrity.visual_evidence: The values in the 'Daily Analysis' sheet match the price trends seen in the opened 'caiso_sp15_2023_8760.csv'.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The pricing data in 'caiso_sp15_2023_8760.csv' is synthetic. The model must use exactly 20 MWh for discharge and 23.529 MWh (20 / 0.85) for charging. A cycle only occurs if (Daily Max Price * 20) - (Daily Min Price * 23.529) > 200. The final file must be an .xlsx file named 'bess_arbitrage_model.xlsx' in the specified directory.
